# Pokémon Unbound auf Deutsch (German Fan-Translation)

> A community-driven German (Deutsch) localization of Pokémon Unbound, a Pokémon FireRed ROM hack built on the CFRU ecosystem. This repository is documentation, terminology, and human-QA coordination for the translation. It contains **no ROM, no patched ROM, and no public patch** — any future release will be patch-only (bring your own legal base ROM).

Key facts:
- Language: German (Deutsch) localization of an English ROM hack.
- Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem.
- Status: Alpha / work in progress; AI-assisted, human-reviewed in batches.
- Distribution policy: patch-only, no ROMs or commercial assets are hosted or shared.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders; unofficial fan project.
